name: asdair-browser-runner
description: BUILD-015 AsdAIr Stage 1 - the bounded, supervised ASDA browser runner. Drives a VISIBLE dedicated Chrome profile over the Chrome DevTools Protocol against exactly one claimed asdair.browser_build_request, under a single-writer lease with a heartbeat and a bounded expiry. Pauses, resumes, hands the browser to a human, and stops at basket-ready. Never checks out, never pays, never books or changes a delivery slot, never enters credentials, never enables or accepts a substitute.
